passages.provision_quote: A public agency shall not impose or enforce any minimum automobile parking requirement on a residential, commercial, or other development project if the project is located within one-half mile of public transit.
passages.note: Removes local minimum parking requirements near transit; a land-use rule on private development, not a transportation-investment split (annex 'Parking rules on private builders').
Floor vote (Aye) concurring in Senate amendments to AB 2097; same adjacent parking-minimums instrument as the bill text.

rows.reasoning: AB 2097 bars local minimum parking requirements within one-half mile of transit; the annex's 'Parking rules on private builders' hard case holds that removing parking minimums for private development is a land-use rule, not transportation investment, so it is adjacent to 'Where should government focus its transportation investment?' No passage survives V2, so the row is BLANK.
